meta.rule: Single source of truth for every number on the site. Never write a figure here that is not backed by a public transaction hash or a public grading certificate number.

config.creatorFeeNote: Bonding-curve rate (0.300%). After graduation the creator fee scales DOWN with market cap, from 0.300% (below 420 SOL) to 0.050% (above 98,240 SOL). Non-canonical pools pay 0%. Any projection using this flat rate is an upper bound.

target.note: Set reference and price both confirmed. Estimate is deliberately conservative.

wallets.custodyNote: Single-signature wallet. Auditable by anyone on-chain, but not multisig-secured. Migration to a Squads multisig is planned once the Vault holds enough to justify the ~0.1 SOL deployment cost, and will be published with its transaction trail.
